Overview Summary: Nicole set up your 17hats account in June 2026 with workflows for Theatre, Event and Headshot photography (actors and corporate).
Quick Tip 1: For Theatre projects, be sure to use only the 1st show date as the project date; all other show dates get added as additional events to the same project + start their own workflows
Quick Tip 2: Theatre and Event projects both lead to the ~Theatre/Events Gallery Delivered workflow at the end
Quick Tip 3: To add a client's gallery link to their project (and for automated emails), click the small pencil button on the right side of the project screen to edit, then find the field for the link and paste it in
Quick Tip 4: Watch for the to-do's that indicate an email will send after completion; these emails automatically go after you check it complete
Special Notes: Dashboard is the daily starting point for everyone on the team; workflow and to do items appear there by due date. Pipelines give the bird's eye view of all leads and clients (navigate between pipelines top right). When entering a project, check 'What's coming up in the next 7 days' first, then click into the workflow to see completed and upcoming steps.
Workflow Groups:
🎭 Theatre Workflows: 1, 2
🗓️ Event Workflows: 4, 5, 6
📤 Shared Delivery Workflow: 3
🖼️ Headshot Workflows: 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12
Workflow 1 Description: adding events to calendar, confirming with client, sending invoice
Workflow 1 Steps:
1- 🟣 edit project: add 1st date/time/location & attach "🎭 Theatre 2-Event" workflow (Casey; after workflow started)
2- 🟣 add additional dates/times/locations to project events (DO NOT use for project date) & attach "🎭 Theatre 2-Event" workflow to each (Casey; after above)
3- Send email: Theatre - Available (Casey; after above; moves client to "Waiting on Payment" in pipeline)
4- Send invoice: Theatre (Kate; 28 days before base date)
5- Archive the Project (30 days after base date)
Workflow 2 Description: gallery creation, reminder and gallery sharing
Workflow 2 Steps:
1- Add Tag: +confirmed shoot (automatic upon starting workflow)
2- 🟢 make gallery in Pixiset to expire 30 days after shoot date (Kate; 7 days before base date)
3- Send email: Theatre - Day Before (automated)
4- Add Tag: +editing (automatic on base date; moves client to "Casey: editing" in pipeline)
5- 🟣 dump raw images on computer, bring into lightroom and do full cull as well as press cull (Casey; 1 day after base date)
6- 🟣 Edit press, dump in gallery & save gallery link to project (email will auto-send to contact w/ link) (Casey)
7- 🟣 finish whole gallery; put in Pixieset & archive (email will auto-send to contact w/ link) (Casey)
8- Create Workflow: ~Theatre/Events Gallery Delivered (automatic)

Automations - Lead Capture:
1- Automatic email reply sent to client
2- Client lands in "New Lead" phase of pipeline
3- Project created
4- Workflow starts according to service selected
Automations - Pipelines:
1- Lead lands in "New Lead" upon submitting lead capture form
2- Lead moves to "Contacted" when Follow-up 1 email is sent (Headshots & Events), or when Available email is sent (Theatre)
3- Lead moves to "3 Days Old" 3 days after landing in "Contacted"
4- Lead moves to "7+ Days Old" 4 days after above
5- Lead moves to "Waiting on Payment" after Available email is sent (Theatre)
6- Client moves to "Kate: pre-shoot" upon confirmed booking
7- Client removed from "Kate: pre-shoot" after gallery creation marked completed
8- Client moves to "Casey: editing" on shoot date
9- Client moves to "Kate: proofs" after Casey completes creation of proof with selected headshot
10- Client moves to "Emma Jean: marketing" when Kate completes wetransfer (Headshots) or when Casey selects favs in Pixiset (Theatre/Events)
11- Client removed from "Emma Jean: marketing" when she completes website portfolio (Headshots) or when she uses images for planned posts (Theatre/Events)
